Summary: Initialize Autonomous Market Research Analyst repository and developer tooling
Description: Create app skeleton: FastAPI backend, React frontend, docker-compose with postgres+redis, ruff/black/mypy, pytest, .env.example, Makefile, CI workflow stub.
Business Value: Foundation for all subsequent tickets.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. docker-compose up starts all services. 2. pytest exits 0. 3. ruff and mypy pass. 4. README has exact setup steps.
Technical Notes: Python 3.11+. FastAPI + uvicorn. Redis for job queue. React + TypeScript + Vite.
Testing Requirements: Smoke test: app imports without error. Docker: all services healthy.
Security Requirements: .env not committed. .env.example present.
Definition of Done: All AC met. CI green. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Document system architecture and key technical decisions
Description: Write ARCHITECTURE.md: research request → planner → bounded search tools → evidence store → synthesis agent → citation verifier → human review → report export. Include ADRs for agent framework choice, tool allowlist design, state persistence strategy.
Business Value: Shared mental model prevents design drift across agent implementation tickets.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. ARCHITECTURE.md covers full agent loop. 2. At least 2 ADRs in docs/architecture/. 3. Tool allowlist design documented. 4. State persistence strategy documented.
Technical Notes: Document how agent state is persisted to DB before each step (crash recovery). Document ReAct loop design.
Testing Requirements: Docs review: architecture matches planned implementation.
Security Requirements: None specific.
Definition of Done: ARCHITECTURE.md complete. ADRs stored. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Create core database schema and migration workflow
Description: Model and migrate: research_jobs, plan_steps, tool_calls, sources, evidence, reports, review_decisions. Include indexes on job status, step status, and created_at. Soft delete for jobs.
Business Value: Correct schema prevents data model re-work. Enables crash recovery via DB persistence.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. alembic upgrade head runs clean. 2. downgrade -1 rolls back. 3. All tables have id, created_at, updated_at. 4. research_jobs.status index exists.
Technical Notes: research_jobs.status: pending/planning/running/awaiting_review/completed/failed/cancelled. Foreign keys enforced.
Testing Requirements: Integration: migrate on test DB, verify schema.
Security Requirements: DB credentials in env vars only.
Definition of Done: Migrations run and roll back. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Implement versioned API foundation and error contract
Description: Implement: POST /v1/research-jobs; GET /v1/research-jobs/{id}; DELETE /v1/research-jobs/{id}; POST /v1/research-jobs/{id}/approve; GET /v1/reports/{id}; GET /v1/health; GET /v1/ready. Portfolio error envelope on all responses.
Business Value: Stable API contract for frontend and agent worker to build against.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. All endpoints return correct status codes. 2. Error envelope matches portfolio spec. 3. /health 200. /ready 503 when DB down. 4. Request IDs in all responses.
Technical Notes: See docs/api/api-style-guide.md. X-Request-ID middleware. Pydantic v2 models.
Testing Requirements: API tests: every endpoint, valid/invalid input, error envelope.
Security Requirements: Auth stub only — full auth in P02-05.
Definition of Done: All endpoints tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Implement authentication authorization and configuration security
Description: Implement JWT auth middleware. Users can only access their own research jobs. API key for service workers. Document local dev auth. Startup config validation.
Business Value: Prevents unauthorized access to research jobs and reports.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Unauthenticated → 401. 2. User A cannot access User B's job → 403. 3. Missing env vars → startup failure. 4. Local dev auth in README.
Technical Notes: JWT with python-jose. user_id from JWT in all domain queries. See .kiro/steering/security.md.
Testing Requirements: Security tests: 401, 403, startup failure on missing config.
Security Requirements: No tokens in logs. JWT secret in env var.
Definition of Done: Auth tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Research job lifecycle management
Description: Implement: create job (validates question, enqueues), get job status with step list, cancel running job, list user's jobs with pagination.
Business Value: Users need to start
Technical Notes: Backend
AI-SDLC Phase: 1. Job creation enqueues to Redis. 2. Job status reflects current step. 3. Cancel stops the worker loop. 4. List is paginated. 5. Tests cover all states.
Testing Requirements: Job state machine: pending→planning→running→awaiting_review→completed/failed/cancelled. Cancellation sets a flag checked by the worker.
Security Requirements: BUILD
Definition of Done: Unit: state transitions. Integration: create→queue→status.
column18: Job lifecycle tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Planning and step decomposition agent
Description: Implement planner: LLM call that decomposes research question into 5-8 ordered steps with tool assignments. Validate output schema. Store plan in DB. Enforce max step count (configurable, default 8).
Business Value: Planning is the first agent phase — it determines what work gets done.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Planner produces a valid JSON step plan for a test question. 2. Plan stored in plan_steps table. 3. Output validated against schema. 4. Max step count enforced. 5. Unit test with mocked LLM adapter.
Technical Notes: Output schema: { steps: [{ index, description, tool_name }] }. Validate with Pydantic. If schema invalid, retry once, then fail job. See .kiro/steering/engineering.md rule 7.
Testing Requirements: Unit: planner with mocked adapter. Integration: planner → steps stored in DB.
Security Requirements: LLM API key in env var. No question content in structured logs.
Definition of Done: Planner tested with mocked adapter. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Web search and source collection tools
Description: Implement web_search(query) tool: calls Tavily or Serper API, returns top 5 results with URL and snippet. Implement fetch_page(url) tool: fetches and extracts text from URL (max 2000 tokens). Both tools are allowlisted and logged.
Business Value: Search and fetch are the primary evidence collection tools for the research agent.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. web_search returns results for a test query. 2. fetch_page returns extracted text for a test URL. 3. Oversized responses truncated to 2000 tokens. 4. All tool calls logged with sanitized args. 5. Unit tests with mocked HTTP clients.
Technical Notes: Tool adapter interface: tool_name, execute(args) → ToolResult. Queries sanitized before sending to external API (no PII, no internal terms). Timeout: 30s per call. Max retries: 2.
Testing Requirements: Unit: tool adapters with mocked HTTP. Security: query sanitization test.
Security Requirements: External API keys in env vars. No user PII in tool queries. Queries sanitized before external calls.
Definition of Done: Tool adapters tested. Security test for PII in queries passes. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Evidence store and claim extraction
Description: Implement evidence storage: after each tool call, extract claims from the result and store in evidence table with source URL. Implement evidence retrieval for synthesis phase.
Business Value: Evidence store is the accumulation of facts the synthesis agent uses.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Evidence extracted after each tool call. 2. Each evidence record has source URL. 3. Evidence retrieval returns all evidence for a job. 4. Unit test for claim extractor with mocked LLM.
Technical Notes: Claim extractor: LLM call on tool result → list of claim strings. Output: [{ claim: string, source_url: string }]. Store in evidence table.
Testing Requirements: Unit: claim extractor with mocked LLM. Integration: tool call → evidence stored.
Security Requirements: No raw tool results in structured logs.
Definition of Done: Evidence storage tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Multi-step research orchestration loop
Description: Implement the agent execution loop: read next pending step → call tool → store evidence → mark step complete → check budget/iteration limits → proceed to next step or complete. Handle failures (tool timeout, API error) with retry then fail-step.
Business Value: The execution loop is the core of the autonomous agent.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Loop executes all plan steps in order. 2. Failed step is marked failed with error; loop continues to next step (configurable). 3. Budget cap halts loop. 4. Iteration limit halts loop. 5. All steps end up in a terminal state.
Technical Notes: ReAct loop in workers/research_worker.py. Budget tracked from token counts in model_calls. Dead-letter: if 3 consecutive steps fail
AI-SDLC Phase: mark job as failed and alert.
Testing Requirements: BUILD
Security Requirements: Integration: full loop with mocked tools. Security: budget cap enforcement.
Definition of Done: Budget cap enforced before each LLM call. No credentials in tool args.
Kiro Prompt: Loop tested with mocked tools. Budget cap tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Claim verification and citation validation
Description: Implement verifier: for each claim in evidence, call LLM to verify the claim is supported by the source URL text (fetched). Store verified=true/false on each evidence record. Only verified evidence is used in report generation.
Business Value: Claim verification is what prevents hallucinated citations from reaching the final report.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Verifier marks claims as verified/unverified based on source text. 2. Unverified claims are excluded from synthesis. 3. Verification result stored on evidence record. 4. Unit test with mocked LLM: verified and unverified cases.
Technical Notes: Verifier prompt output: { verified: bool, reason: string }. Validate with Pydantic. Timeout per verification: 30s. See .kiro/specs/project-02/spec.md.
Testing Requirements: Unit: verifier with mocked LLM (verified and unverified cases).
Security Requirements: Source URLs fetched securely (no SSRF — allowlist domains or use safe fetch adapter).
Definition of Done: Verifier tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Report generation and export
Description: Implement synthesizer: LLM call using only verified evidence, produces a structured markdown report with citations. Store report in reports table. Implement export: GET /v1/reports/{id}/export returns markdown or PDF.
Business Value: Report generation is the final AI phase before human review.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Report generated from verified evidence only. 2. Report includes citations linking to source URLs. 3. Export endpoint returns markdown. 4. Unit test with mocked LLM. 5. Report stored in DB.
Technical Notes: Synthesizer prompt: instruct model to write from evidence only, never fabricate, include [source_url] citations. Output stored as report.content_md.
Testing Requirements: Unit: synthesizer with mocked LLM. Integration: verification → report generation. Security: synthesis uses only verified evidence.
Security Requirements: LLM API key in env var. No evidence content in structured logs.
Definition of Done: Report generation tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Human review and approval workflow
Description: Implement approval API: POST /v1/research-jobs/{id}/approve accepts reviewer notes and decision (approve/reject). On approve: mark report as final. On reject: job returns to awaiting_revision state with feedback. Notify user (stub).
Business Value: Human-in-the-loop approval is a hard requirement — no report is final without explicit review.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Approve transitions job to completed. 2. Reject returns job to awaiting_revision. 3. Reviewer ID and decision recorded. 4. Report cannot be exported before approval. 5. Tests cover approve and reject flows.
Technical Notes: Review decision stored in review_decisions table. Export API returns 403 if report not yet approved. Reviewer must be authenticated.
Testing Requirements: Integration: approve and reject flows. Security: export before approval returns 403.
Security Requirements: Reviewer identity from auth context. Export gated on approval.
Definition of Done: Approval workflow tested. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Agent limits budgets and safety controls
Description: Implement and test: max tool calls per job (default 20), max cost per job (default $2.00), max step failures before abort (default 3), query sanitization before external tools. Add rate limiting on job submission (5 jobs/hour per user).
Business Value: Safety limits prevent runaway agents and cost overruns.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Job exceeding step limit is halted with status=limit_exceeded. 2. Job exceeding cost cap is halted. 3. Rate limiting on job submission returns 429. 4. Query sanitization removes PII patterns before external tool calls. 5. All limits configurable via env vars.
Technical Notes: Store cost_usd on research_jobs
AI-SDLC Phase: updated after each LLM call. Limits checked at the start of each step. Rate limiting with Redis (slidingwindow).
Testing Requirements: SECURE
Security Requirements: Security tests: step limit, cost limit, rate limit, PII in query sanitization.
Definition of Done: All limits enforced. Limits configurable — no hardcoded values.
Kiro Prompt: All limit tests pass. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Research job status UI
Description: Build React UI: job submission form (research question input), job list with status indicators, step progress timeline, report viewer with citations. Use React Query for data fetching and polling.
Business Value: Users need a UI to submit jobs
Technical Notes: Frontend
AI-SDLC Phase: 1. Job can be submitted from the UI. 2. Job status updates via polling (every 5s while running). 3. Step timeline shows completed/running/failed steps. 4. Report with citations is readable. 5. Accessible (keyboard nav, ARIA labels).
Testing Requirements: React + TypeScript + Vite. React Query for polling. TailwindCSS or component library. Accessible per WCAG 2.1 AA requirements from .kiro/steering/engineering.md.
Security Requirements: BUILD
Definition of Done: Unit: React components with React Testing Library. E2E: submit job → see status update.
Kiro Prompt: Auth token stored securely (httpOnly cookie or memory — not localStorage).
column18: UI components tested. E2E test passes. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Add project-specific evaluation and regression test harness
Description: Build evaluation: create evaluation/datasets/v1.0/ with 10 research questions and ground-truth claims. Implement metrics: source_coverage, claim_accuracy, hallucination_rate, report_completeness. Store baseline. Implement regression runner.
Business Value: Measured quality establishes credibility of the research agent.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Eval runner executes on all 10 test questions. 2. Metrics reported per-case and in aggregate. 3. Baseline stored in evaluation/regression/baseline.json. 4. Regression runner compares against baseline. 5. Human can inspect per-case failures.
Technical Notes: Ground truth: 10 research questions with expected_sources (URLs) and expected_claims (strings). claim_accuracy: % of report claims verifiable against expected_sources. See docs/evaluation/evaluation-framework.md.
Testing Requirements: Evaluation: run against test dataset. Regression: compare against baseline.
Security Requirements: Evaluation dataset contains no PII.
Definition of Done: Evaluation runs. Baseline stored. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Add observability audit events and operational dashboards
Description: Add structured logging, Prometheus metrics (research_jobs_total, tool_calls_total, ai_cost_usd_total, job_duration_seconds), audit events (job created/approved/completed), and dashboard documentation.
Business Value: Operational visibility is required before production use.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. All requests produce structured JSON logs. 2. /metrics returns Prometheus metrics. 3. Audit events written for job lifecycle. 4. Dashboard documented in OPERATIONS.md.
Technical Notes: Log job events without logging question/report content. Audit events separate from application logs.
Testing Requirements: Integration: verify log format. Metrics: spot-check counters after test job.
Security Requirements: No research content in logs.
Definition of Done: Observability tested. OPERATIONS.md updated. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Implement security and privacy controls for project-specific risks
Description: Threat-model P02. Implement and test: tool allowlist enforcement, query PII sanitization, agent budget cap, job isolation (user A cannot access user B's jobs), tool argument injection prevention. Complete security gate checklist.
Business Value: Security hardening before release.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Tool allowlist test: agent cannot call unlisted tool. 2. PII sanitization test: email address removed from query before external call. 3. Budget cap test. 4. Job isolation test (403). 5. Security gate checklist in docs/security/.
Technical Notes: Allowlist: only web_search and fetch_page. Argument injection: validate tool args against schema before execution. See .kiro/steering/security.md.
Testing Requirements: Security tests: tool allowlist, PII in query, budget cap, job isolation.
Security Requirements: Completed security checklist stored. No unmitigated critical findings.
Definition of Done: Security gate signed off. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Add CI/CD containerization and deployment documentation
Description: GitHub Actions CI: lint, type-check, secret scan, pip-audit, unit tests, integration tests. Dockerfile (multi-stage, non-root). docker-compose.yml. DEPLOYMENT.md with migration steps and rollback.
Business Value: Production readiness before release gate.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. CI pipeline passes. 2. Dockerfile builds. 3. docker-compose up works. 4. DEPLOYMENT.md complete. 5. pip-audit: no high/critical CVEs.
Technical Notes: CI runs on every PR. Secret scan with detect-secrets. See .kiro/steering/engineering.md.
Testing Requirements: CI: all steps pass. Docker: image builds and starts.
Security Requirements: detect-secrets and pip-audit in CI.
Definition of Done: CI passing. DEPLOYMENT.md complete. Human reviewer approved.

Summary: Deliver integrated demo workflow and release acceptance report
Description: Connect all modules into repeatable demo: submit question → agent runs 6 steps → human approves report → export markdown with citations. Write release acceptance report: actual test results, evaluation results, known limitations.
Business Value: Demo and report are the release (Gate G5) evidence package.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Demo runs end-to-end. 2. Final report has citations traceable to source URLs. 3. Evaluation report included. 4. Known limitations documented. 5. Human approval obtained.
Technical Notes: Demo script in scripts/demo.py. Report in docs/operations/release-P02-v1.0.md. Real numbers only — no invented results.
Testing Requirements: E2E: run demo. Report: spot-check 3 citations.
Security Requirements: No secrets in demo data.
Definition of Done: Demo passes. Report written with real results. Human approval (Gate G5) obtained.
